description: Generate the Next.js App Router scaffold with exact-pinned dependencies, project-local pnpm manifest/lockfile, TypeScript/Tailwind config, .gitignore, and starter.json. Corresponds to subtask 2.1.
steps: Create nextjs-supabase-saas/ directory at the repository root

Initialize a Next.js App Router project with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS using exact-pinned versions: next@15 (latest stable), react@19, react-dom@19, typescript@5.x, tailwindcss@4.x, @tailwindcss/postcss, postcss. Use pnpm as the package manager with packageManager field in package.json.
Create package.json with exact-pinned direct dependencies (not ranges), scripts for dev/build/start/lint/typecheck/test, and packageManager field for pnpm
Generate pnpm-lock.yaml by running pnpm install
Create tsconfig.json with strict mode, Next.js recommended paths, and App Router settings
Create next.config.ts with minimal App Router configuration
Create postcss.config.mjs for Tailwind CSS v4
Create app/globals.css with Tailwind v4 import (@import 'tailwindcss')
Create a minimal app/layout.tsx root layout with metadata
Create a minimal app/page.tsx placeholder public page

Create starter.json with immutable identity projection matching catalog entry #1: id=1, folder=nextjs-supabase-saas, family=Web SaaS, useCase=General multi-tenant SaaS, framework=Next.js App Router, runtime=Node LTS, technologies=[TypeScript, Supabase Auth, Supabase Postgres, Stripe, Resend, Tailwind], auth=Supabase Auth, data=Supabase Postgres, monetization=Stripe subscriptions, integrations=[Resend]
Verify the project builds successfully with pnpm run build
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-supabase-saas/package.json exists with exact-pinned direct dependencies and correct scripts
nextjs-supabase-saas/pnpm-lock.yaml exists and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds
nextjs-supabase-saas/starter.json matches the catalog entry #1 identity fields
pnpm run build completes without errors in the nextjs-supabase-saas directory
TypeScript strict mode is enabled in tsconfig.json
